decisions.title: Cohort preview is read-only: calls resolveCohort with no onPageFetched
decisions.chose: GET /internal/practice-reports/cohort-preview backs onto the shared resolveCohort/evaluateGuards from @attribution-service/practice-cohort (extracted in #300), calling resolveCohort with no onPageFetched argument.
decisions.rejected: Passing a callback that emits its own dashboard-scoped metric.
decisions.why: Omitting the callback is the mechanism by which a read-only preview has no code path to move a batch counter, per the callback boundary #300 built.

provenanceTrail.reason: Mutation-checked: giving the preview an onPageFetched that emits batch.cohort.page_fetched fails the zero-batch-metrics test exactly.
apps/api suite green (403 tests, 26 files); build + biome clean; openapi-lint at the 6-warning baseline, no new warnings.

decisions.title: optOutVerified: false makes the opt-out gap machine-readable
decisions.chose: The response always sets optOutVerified: false; tests assert both zero OPTED_OUT entries and the flag present and false.
decisions.rejected: Omitting the field, or leaving OPTED_OUT reachable in the schema without comment.
decisions.why: isPracticeOptedOut reads practice.optedOut, which PracticeEntity does not declare (NEV-1412 Wont Fix), so OPTED_OUT can never fire; the response says so rather than implying it checked.

decisions.title: Multi-page coverage test seeds past the pagination boundary
decisions.chose: The pagination test seeds 105 practices against a page size of 100 so the request actually crosses a page boundary.
decisions.rejected: Seeding fewer than 100 for a faster single-page test.
decisions.why: Fewer practices would pass without ever paginating past page one; seeding past the boundary is what exercises the real multi-page path.

closed.reason: apps/api suite green (403 tests, 26 files); build + biome clean; openapi-lint at the 6-warning baseline, no new warnings.
